title: Hartland, looking south down Main Street before 1907 fire
description: This view shows Hartland's Main Street looking north before the 1907 fire, which destroyed all the buildings on the left up to the ninth building and part of the tenth.
credit: Doris Kennedy Collection — Hartland Community Historical Society
